decision.reason: [ev-8b7179788e16] is a one-line release-note title. It names the removed field (spec.controllerConfigRef) and says it was removed from "package types". It doesn't name which package kinds, API group or version are affected, so the subject and applicability can't be typed. It also doesn't say what happens to existing resources or manifests that still set the field, and it doesn't name a replacement. It only points to PR #6520, so the consequence is unstated and we need that PR, an upgrade guide or a CRD schema diff.
